question: Sitara Devi was famous for which of the following classical dances?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sitara Devi** was known for **Kathak**, which is a classical dance form of North India that involves storytelling, intricate footwork, and graceful movements of hands and arms.
 
• Sitara Devi was a world-famous Kathak dancer, singer, and actress.
 
 
• She was **born **to her **father Sukhdev Maharaj** and her **mother was Matsya Kumari** on **8 November 1920 in Kolkata.**
 
• She is known as **"Queen of Kathak"**
 
• She was also referred to as the** "Empress of Dancing" or "Nritya Samrajni" by Rabindranath Tagore.**
 
• She was the recipient of several awards and accolades like the **Sangeet Natak Academy award (1969)**, **Padma Shri(1973)**, **Kalidas Samman 1995**, and **Nritya Nipuna**.
 
• She **died **at the age of 94 on** November 25, 2014.**
 
 
 
• **Kathak **is a **classical dance** form of **North India basically Uttar Pradesh.**
 
 
• It is a storytelling dance that involves intricate footwork, spins, and graceful movements of the hands and arms.
 
• The **themes **of Kathak are **often romantic or devotional in nature.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathakali **is a classical dance form of **Kerala**.

 
 
• It is a highly stylized and **ritualistic dance drama** that combines elements of ballet, opera, masque, and pantomime.
 
• The performers wear **elaborate costumes and makeup** to **depict characters from Indian mythology.**
 
 
 
• **Bharatnatyam **is a classical dance form of **Tamil Nadu.**
 
 
• It is a highly expressive dance that involves intricate footwork, hand gestures, and facial expressions.
 
• The **themes **of Bharatnatyam are **often devotional in nature,** and the dance is often performed in temples.
 
 
 
• **Manipuri **is a classical dance form of **Manipur**.
 
 
• It is a graceful and fluid dance that involves delicate hand gestures, flowing movements, and intricate footwork.
 
• The **themes **of Manipuri are** often mythological or devotional** in nature.
